arg.name: side
arg.description: Select the hand model and default servo IDs: 1 for right, 2 for left.

arg.name: servo_ids
arg.description: Eight unique physical IDs (0 to 253), in index, middle, ring, thumb order, motor 1 then 2. Defaults to the mapping for side.

arg.name: middle_pos
arg.description: Required for hardware: eight calibration angles for the connected hand, in degrees and in ascending physical servo ID order. Unused in simulation.

arg.name: namespace
arg.description: Namespace for the hand controllers, topics and trajectory action.

arg.name: baudrate
arg.description: Serial baud rate in bits per second. Must match all eight servos.

arg.name: serial_timeout
arg.description: Serial packet timeout in seconds (greater than 0, at most 5).

arg.name: control_rate
arg.description: Hardware control loop rate in Hz (integer, 1 to 1000). Gazebo uses config/ros2_controllers.yaml.

arg.name: goal_speed
arg.description: Servo goal speed in rad/s. Use a positive speed that encodes to a nonzero register value.

arg.name: motor_min_deg
arg.description: Lower motor angle limit in degrees relative to the calibrated middle pose.

arg.name: motor_max_deg
arg.description: Upper motor angle limit in degrees relative to the calibrated middle pose.

arg.name: disable_torque_on_shutdown
arg.description: Request torque off when the hardware driver shuts down normally.

arg.name: use_sim
arg.description: Run the hand in Gazebo Harmonic.

arg.name: gui
arg.description: Show the Gazebo window when use_sim is true.

arg.name: use_rviz
arg.description: Open RViz to display the hand pose.

arg.name: rqt
arg.description: Open the rqt joint trajectory controller sliders.

let.name: description
let.value: $(command '$(var generate) "$(var side)" "$(var servo_ids)" "$(var middle_pos)" $(var control_rate) "$(var namespace)" $(var use_sim) "$(var port)" $(var baudrate) $(var serial_timeout) $(var goal_speed) $(var motor_min_deg) $(var motor_max_deg) $(var disable_torque_on_shutdown)')
